title: Add the deployment to the repository
description: `papyrus.config.ts`, `amplify/`, `amplify.yml`, `infra/`, one Papyrus pin, and `sites/<site-id>/` from the scaffold. Start from the Shipped-web wrappers if the scaffold is not ready.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Include a site list (sites.json: id, tenant id, name, domain, theme) so the second site is an entry, not a new folder of code. Pin Papyrus once for the whole repository.
